answer: Timed Contribution Ledger. Each identity must complete a verified micro-task (data labeling, code review) before its messages echo to the network. The ledger tracks response latency; only identities maintaining a rolling median at the network's zenith percentile gain routing priority. Attacker cost: sustained real labor across many simultaneous identities, not a one-time payment. Coordination stalls at the wharf of human throughput limits.
